assessments.mechanism: Scale effective independent information channels/diversity rather than raw homogeneous agent count.
assessments.clean_scope: 2026 MAS reasoning configurations; 2 diverse agents can match/exceed 16 homogeneous in that paper, not a universal ratio.
assessments.o_comparison: O's strategy explicitly detects method-family concentration and mandates materially heterogeneous search. It has not measured effective-channel diversity or a 2-diverse-vs-16-homogeneous matched MAS comparison.

assessments.mechanism: Route tasks to MAS topologies based on decomposability, sequentiality, tool intensity, and baseline capability.
assessments.clean_scope: Controlled 260-configuration study across six benchmarks; topology effects range strongly positive to strongly negative within that tested set.
assessments.o_comparison: No MAS topology selector or topology-task matching evaluation was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Autonomous asynchronous multi-agent co-evolution with persistent knowledge and local verification.
assessments.clean_scope: CORAL evidence is evaluator-rich open-ended optimization; shared memory is part of the tested mechanism and may conflict with strict independent exploration settings.
assessments.o_comparison: O has parallel isolated work, persistent evidence/Candidates, and local verification primitives, but no autonomous co-evolving population/shared-memory system matching CORAL.

assessments.mechanism: Quality-diversity/niching for LLM-assisted evolutionary search with adaptive niche granularity.
assessments.clean_scope: PartEvo evidence on four automated algorithm-discovery benchmarks; K=4 at N=16 is empirical and non-universal.
assessments.o_comparison: No MAP-Elites/niching/quality-diversity archive mechanism or matched niche-granularity experiment was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Evolve the multi-agent configuration itself, with reusable configuration pools plus experience memory.
assessments.clean_scope: EvoMAS evidence on BBEH/WorkBench/SWE-Bench family; some rewards use LLM-as-judge and scope must remain benchmark-specific.
assessments.o_comparison: O evolves/scopes Candidates but not MAS role/model/tool topology populations, and no EvoMAS-like configuration-pool experiment was found.
